name: review_service_report
description: Call after each technician service report or correction. Send only the latest technician utterance verbatim as report_text. The backend returns missing evidence, contradictions, readiness, and the next question. Never claim completion without this tool result.
pre_call_message: I am checking what is still missing from the report.

job_id.description: The fixed private call-routing key supplied in the job_id context variable. It is not the spoken site ID. Do not invent, change or read it aloud.

report_text.description: Latest technician utterance verbatim. Preserve negations, corrections, IDs, measured values, and units. Do not summarize, translate, or fabricate evidence.
